# resolve_coordinate_spec { #timetoalign.resolve_coordinate_spec }

```python
resolve_coordinate_spec(spec, *, timeline_id=None)
```

Decompose a coordinate specification without converting its unit.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type                                                     | Description                                           | Default    |
|-------------|----------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| spec        | [CoordinateSpec](`timetoalign.core.time.CoordinateSpec`) | Coordinate specification to decompose.                | _required_ |
| timeline_id | [str](`str`) \| None                                     | Optional timeline ID for otherwise unqualified input. | `None`     |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                             | Description                                          |
|--------|------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ResolvedCoordinate](`timetoalign.core.time.ResolvedCoordinate`) | The numeric value and any timeline or unit metadata. |

## Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                |
|--------|----------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If an explicit timeline ID conflicts with an IdCoordinate. |
|        | [TypeError](`TypeError`)   | If spec is not a supported coordinate specification.       |
